title: Median sale prices
text: Median sale prices are now $1.28M, down 26.3% from a year ago and down 10% from five years ago. Buyers comparing budgets should use the latest completed sales as their reference point.

title: Price per square foot
text: Price per square foot is $759, down 7.3% from a year ago. Buyers comparing homes of similar size and condition should look closely at what those homes actually sold for.

title: Available homes
text: There are 165 homes available, up 1.9% from a year ago and up 12.2% from five years ago. Buyers have a slightly wider selection to choose from.

title: Median days on market
text: The median days on market is 60, down 11.8% from a year ago. Sellers can plan a marketing timeline around that figure, though it is not a promised sale date.

title: Homes sold
text: Homes sold total 36 in the 3 months ending October, down 26.5% from a year ago. Sellers should weigh these completed transactions when reviewing their asking price.

title: Sales above, at and below asking
text: Most homes sold below asking, more common than last year.

title: Local happenings
text: Los Angeles County broke ground October 3 on a reimagined Charles White Park in Altadena, with an inclusive playground designed by Disney Imagineers, a splash pad, lighted pickleball courts, a new recreation center, native shade trees, accessible walkways, a demonstration garden, and public art across the five-acre park.

title: Sale-to-list percentage
text: Homes are selling for about 3% under their final asking price. Sellers can review completed comparable sales before choosing an asking price.
